mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by > 1pp y-o-y and the unemployment rate is above 6%, it signals a supply-driven economic slowdown that will hurt corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO y-o-y growth < -1pp and UNRATE > 6% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid 1pp increase in the federal funds rate over 3 months, when starting from a level above 3%, signals a tightening monetary policy that will raise borrowing costs and pressure equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 3% and rises > 1pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth accelerates by > 2pp y-o-y and consumer sentiment is above its 12-month average, it signals a strengthening consumer demand environment that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST y-o-y growth > 2pp and RSAFS > 12-month avg but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in payroll employment, defined as three consecutive monthly declines, signals a weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 3 consecutive monthly PAYEMS declines but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate rises above 3% y-o-y and the federal funds rate is below 2%, it signals an inflationary regime that will erode real equity returns, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL y-o-y > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth accelerates by > 1pp q-o-q and the unemployment rate is below 5%, it signals a strong demand environment that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 q-o-q growth > 1pp and UNRATE < 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.
